text_block_list.text:
...Huh? 
Vitality is welling up from deep within 
me—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It's as if the breath of the wilderness 
is coursing through my veins. 
Ah, I just want to run with all my 
might...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A mystery of mother nature...? No, in this 
case, 
perhaps it's the mystery of Tracen 
Academy? Hehe!
